subject: Little nudge on the quote
text:
Hi there,

Just popping up again after two days. No worries if you’ve been buried! I’m keen to lock the website transfer dates so I can clear my calendar next month. The proposal looked great, and I’ve already cleared it with the client. If the invoice needs the new bank details, I can send those quickly. Otherwise, could you let me know today whether we’re good to proceed? I don’t want this slipping past next week, because the launch is starting to feel a little tight on my end again.

Cheers,
